name: team_planning_scenarios
description: List the scenarios of a Team Planning plan the caller is in. The baseline comes first: its id is the plan's, it stands on the base date and has no parent, relation or end. Each other scenario has its parent_id, its relation ('then' follows the parent, 'instead' is an alternative to it, 'on' is the rest of a split step, sitting on its agreed part), its period, what it is for, if an editor has said, and changes: how many subjects and facets it still changes, the count its Removed scenarios entry keeps once it is removed. state says where it stands on the timeline: 'closed' for a step closed with team_planning_close_step, with closed_on, the UTC day it was closed, and closed_by; 'not_taken' for a scenario a closed step replaced; 'ready_to_close' for the step that can close next; otherwise 'open'. Every scenario but the one ready carries not_closable_because, saying why it can't close; the baseline is always 'open'. Refused, as an unknown plan, unless the caller is a member.
